A World-Changing Company

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

As a Software Developer in Palantir’s Mixed Reality Group (MRG), you will join a Tier 1 team of researchers, 3D artists, immersive UX designers, and cross-discipline engineers to bring the most exquisite software of our time to the factory floor, the battlefield, and the briefing room.

You will collaborate with customers, operators, MR designers, and Forward Deployed Engineers to deliver force-multiplying apps that exceed tomorrow’s requirements today.

Further, you will work on high-impact, mission-critical flows in both 3D mixed reality and 2D end-user devices while fielding performance-sensitive infrastructure for bespoke next-generation mixed reality hardware, sensors, and data platforms.

Architect, develop, debug, document, and deploy performant high-FPS Mixed Reality applications
Invent and improve novel techniques in immersive user experiences
Deliver excellent products that command confidence and delight our users
Rapidly develop prototypes and deployable code in augmented reality, virtual reality, and other immersive 2D and 3D user experiences
Creating performant, power-efficient apps for mobile and embedded devices
Leveraging modern application building paradigms, using PaaS and IaaS for GPU rendering, scaling, and clustering
Technologies We Use
Unity
C#, Java, TypeScript, Rust, Go, C/C++
Android tools (Android Studio, adb, etc.)
What We Value
Attentiveness to customer needs
Tracking and executing multiple tasks in parallel, pivoting rapidly based on customer and business needs
Dogged determination to develop reliable products that our users can trust for mission-critical operations
Challenging dogma, fighting fixed mindsets, burning down bureaucracy at every opportunity
Understanding of Defense and Intel industry product lifecycles
Experience with Unity, Unreal, or similar game engines
What We Require
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science OR equivalent job experience
2+ years technical engineering experience with programming in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python
Active US Security Clearance, or ability and willingness to obtain one

At SyncVR Medical , we build immersive technology for places where it truly matters. Our XR platform is used in hospitals across Europe to support patients during care and to help healthcare professionals work more effectively.

By combining medical insight with cutting-edge immersive technology, we create solutions that are practical, scalable, and clinically meaningful.

As a growing medtech scale-up, we are continuously expanding how XR can be applied in healthcare, from patient-focused experiences to new solutions that support training, education, and professional development. With a strong presence in 6 countries, SyncVR Medical is shaping the future of immersive technology in healthcare.

Tasks As an XR Developer within our Education project team, you are responsible for the technical realization of state-of-the-art medical simulations. You will work in a high-performance environment alongside top-tier 3D artists and medical experts to build scalable, AI-enhanced training modules. Your daily technical tasks:

Unity Development: Write clean, modular C# code to build interactive medical procedures, ensuring systems are flexible enough to be reused across dozens of different surgical and anesthetic modules.

Art-to-Engine Integration: Work hand-in-hand with our 3D artists to bridge the gap between high-fidelity assets and engine performance. You’ll be the "engine-master" who ensures the lighting, shaders, and assets look incredible while maintaining a steady FPS on standalone headsets (Quest 3).

AI Implementation: Proactively research and integrate AI tools to speed up development workflows and create dynamic, non-linear training scenarios.

Clinical Logic Programming: Translate complex medical protocols into robust state-machine logic, ensuring virtual medical equipment and patient reactions behave exactly as they would in a real Operating Room.

Data & Interoperability: Implement standards such as xAPI telemetry to track student progress and ensure the modules communicate seamlessly with centralized digital infrastructures and Learning Management Systems (LRS).

Hands-on 3D Development: You have 2–5 years of professional experience building real-time Unity applications and environments, taking ownership from concept through delivery.

Advanced Unity Expertise: You are highly proficient in Unity and feel confident shipping features, improving existing systems, and solving complex technical challenges.

Production Team Experience: You have worked in game studios, XR agencies, or industrial simulation companies, and understand what it takes to deliver real-world 3D projects.

Bonus: Simulation-Driven Work: You have experience creating digital training, serious games, or simulation-based projects where accuracy, usability, and performance are critical.

Build for Impact: Your work will power XR simulations that actually improve patient care and train healthcare professionals. What you create matters.

Grow Fast: This is a launchpad: grow your skills, take on responsibility, and accelerate toward senior or leadership roles.

Be Part of Something Meaningful: Join a fast-moving medtech scale-up with real adoption in hospitals across Europe and a mission you can be proud of.

About Voodoo
Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. With 1000 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Hole.io , alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.
Team
Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. The Core Games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, while the Live Games team focuses on increasing engagement and extending the success of our existing games.
Joining our Live Games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games, while also embracing exciting new entrepreneurial ventures. With over 7 billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating over $20 million per year, we are the world’s largest and most successful hybrid publisher.
You will join the Live Studios team. Our main mission is to transform hypercasual titles into deep, engaging midcore games by developing richer gameplay experiences, stronger progression systems, and long-term player engagement.
The studio is currently working on titles including Epic Plane Evolution, Path of Kings, Gear Fight and Archery Clash.
Role

Modify and iterate on Unity projects across our portfolio of hybrid-casual and midcore games
Create custom gameplay setups, scenes, animations, environments, skins, and visual assets
Prototype gameplay variations and concepts for advertising
Record, edit, and upload gameplay videos for creative testing
Share modified builds with the Marketing and User Acquisition teams
Analyze creative performance and benchmark competitors to improve results
Profile
Strong Unity skills and experience modifying existing game projects
Interest in mobile games, particularly hybrid-casual, casual, or midcore titles
Creative, curious, and comfortable experimenting independently
Basic knowledge in motion tools such as DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro or CapCut Desktop
Able to work across multiple projects and adapt quickly
Fluent in spoken and written English or Russian
